body:
Yes I referenced that, but eventually what I needed was this: 
https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/reference.html#searchparameters

And from there I could figure out the values for search parameters:
`idx, fD, dFR` etc. Then from there I can build a query string to pass to the page pretty easily:
`/?q=mysearchterm&dFR[category][0]=disjunctiveFacet&fR=facet`.

Is there somewhere that defines all the different mapping values you can set?

``` js
urlSync: {
  trackedParameters: ['query', 'page', 'attribute:*'],
  mapping: {
    p: 'page',
    q: 'query',
    fR: 'facetRefinement',
    dFR: 'disjunctiveFacetRefinement'
      //what else?
  }
}

```

Btw, thanks for all your great help :)
